control_id.description: exactly as given in the prompt

title.description: the finding in one line, in the engineer's words (not the control's title)

meaning.description: what the alarm actually says, one or two sentences

act_when.description: when it is worth acting on, from the sources

ignore_when.description: when to leave it alone and why, from the sources

text.description: one concrete step: console path or CLI command with <placeholders>, and what to verify

source.description: the id of the source this step comes from (a mod:... id or a URL from the prompt)

saving.description: the saving formula in words, with the quantities the rule can read; 'none: a security control' when there is no saving

references.description: URLs cited, from the sources only

gaps.description: a list (possibly empty) of short items: what the sources do not say that a colleague would want to know

confidence.description: a number between 0 and 1 (not a word): how fully the sources support the playbook
